newsitem.title: USA: Ultimate to acquire Audio King.
newsitem.headline: Ultimate to acquire Audio King.

text.p: Electronics retailers Ultimate Electronics Inc and Audio King Corp said on Tuesday they reached an agreement for Ultimate Electronics to acquire all the shares of Audio King.

Each outstanding share of Audio King at the time of the merger will be converted into either $1.75, or .7 shares, of Ultimate Electronics stock at the election of each Audio King shareholder, the companies said in a joint statement.

Ultimate and Audio King said shareholder elections will be adjusted on a pro rata basis, however, so that 50 percent of the Audio King shares are converted into Ultimate Electronics stock and 50 percent are converted into cash.
Audio King shareholders are not expected to recognize any taxable gain or loss in connection with any Ultimate Electronics stock they receive, the companies said.

The deal is subject to Audio King shareholder approval, registration of Ultimate Electronics shares to be issued, final bank approval, satisfaction of antitrust regulations and completion of due diligence.

Ultimate Electronics expects to obtain additional financing for the transaction through a $4 million term loan with Norwest Bank, said the companies, which expect to complete the deal prior to June 1, 1997.
Audio King had $35,300,000 in sales for the six months ended December 31, 1996 and $65,600,000 in sales for the year ended June 30, 1996.
Ultimate Electronics had $260,300,000 in sales for the year ended January 31, 1997.
